title: Input and output
description:
Write a program that reads a name and a birth year (one per line), then greets the person and says how old they turn in 2026:

```
Name? Ada
Birth year? 1990
Hello, Ada!
In 2026 you turn 36.
```

The starter already prints the prompts and reads the two answers into `name` (text) and `year` (an `i32`); lesson 1.05 explains how that reading code works. Your part is the output: print the two lines with `println!`, filling in the name and working out the age with arithmetic.
hints: `{name}` inside the format string prints the variable `name`: `println!("Hello, {name}!");`.
The age is `2026 - year`; an expression goes in `{}` with the value after the format string: `println!("In 2026 you turn {}.", 2026 - year);`.

examples.name: Ada
examples.expected:
Name? Birth year? Hello, Ada!
In 2026 you turn 36.

examples.name: a two-word name
examples.expected:
Name? Birth year? Hello, Grace Hopper!
In 2026 you turn 16.
